Former simulation blocker resolved for the explicitly bound reference (2026-10-08): Runtime must use the scoped MnO2 reverse/temperature limits instead of the generic fixed 3% envelope. Resolution: The archived T491 datasheet (already the entry's document) gives the case-C 16 V row (p10: 47 uF, DCL 7.5 uA, ESR 1.0 ohm, ripple 332 mA) and the temperature-dependent MnO2 limits (p14 derating 50%/33%/67%, p15 transient reverse 15/5/1%). The recipe replaces the class template's fixed 3% reverse flag with these scoped limits as sourced critical facts (new DERIVED volt-valued fields so they are finite scalars in V), and drops the class flag bits. Note the class/bench 3% envelope is NOT conservative at 125 C, where T491 allows only 1%.
